d1.metric: per-window d(w) = NLL_theta(w) - NLL_N(w) (Pilot section 5 general damage); D1-all = mean over 4 domains of the domain means; D1-diff = over books, c4, wikitext; D1-same = fineweb

anchor_source_groups.basis: the Stage 1 fineweb windows come from the held-out FineWeb-Edu validation shard of SandyResearch/fineweb-edu-shuffled, the anchor source (research/mini_mythos/stage1/README.md evaluation-set table)

d1.window_rule: each window has at most 256 tokens of the protocol tokenizer (the first 256); a window with fewer tokens is used at its full length; the ids fed to the model are these truncated ids themselves, not decoded and re-encoded; n_w (protocol section 5) is their number

dev.rule: per domain all 100 rows with split == 'dev', file order; exclude units triggering L8, then L6

test.rule: per domain the rows with split == 'test' in file order, skipping the first 25 test rows of the domain (the E1-PILOT TEST windows); exclude units triggering L8, then L6, then windows whose ids equal those of a DEV window; take the first 100 per domain; fewer than 100 -> ST10

d1.reading_rule: test rows are matched on the row-prefix bytes only until section 10 step 10 (protocol section 0)

d2.metric: c_theta(i) = 1[s(i, correct letter) > max over other letters] (ties wrong); Acc_D2 = mean; damage e_theta(i) = c_N(i) - c_theta(i), D2 = mean e = -dAcc
d2.prompt:
I + '

' + question.strip() + '
' + 'A. ' + c0 + '
' + 'B. ' + c1 + '
' + 'C. ' + c2 + '
' + 'D. ' + c3; I = 'Answer the following multiple choice question with the letter of the correct option.'; ci = str(option i).strip(), dataset order
d2.scoring: chat(p) + 'The answer is' + ' ' + letter, letter in A, B, C, D; chat as for qa; ' A', ' B', ' C', ' D' are single tokens 362, 425, 356, 422; only that token is scored (log-probability of the next token after the context); protocol sections 0 and 7.1
d2.unrelated_to_facts: the V1 entities and answers are randomly generated fictional strings; D2 items are existing real-world questions; L8 excludes any item containing a V1 string

arc.fields: id, question, choices {text, label}, answerKey; only items with exactly 4 labels; labels in the given order map to A-D; subject field holds the item id
arc.dev_order: rows of Challenge validation then Easy validation (indices 0..868), rng_rule(DATA_SEED, 'd2:arc:validation:order').shuffle
arc.test_order: rows of Challenge test then Easy test (indices 0..3547), rng_rule(DATA_SEED, 'd2:arc:test:order').shuffle

d2.verification: reports/authoring/d2_dataset_metadata.txt (Hub API revision, license, LFS oids; sha256 of the downloaded files equal the oids)

dev.rule: in dev_order, exclude: not exactly 4 options or answer outside A-D; L8 hit (a V1 string as a whole word); L6 hit (shares a word 13-gram with anchor_text); take the first 800

test.rule: in test_order, exclude the same and items whose prompt equals a DEV prompt; take the first 800; fewer -> ST10

d2.reading_rule: before section 10 step 10 only the parquet footer (row count) of a TEST source is read (protocol section 0)

statistics.d1_resampling: within domains, in the order books, c4, fineweb, wikitext (only the domains of the metric); r.choices(windows, k=n_domain); statistic = mean of the domain means; both models use the same drawn windows
statistics.seed_average: average the 3 seeds' values per unit, then bootstrap; per-seed bootstraps reported; seed min, max and sample SD of the point estimates reported
statistics.sigma_N: sample SD (denominator B - 1) of the 10,000 bootstrap values of N's level statistic on the DEV set: D1 metrics: mean of domain means of NLL_N(w); D2: Acc_D2(N)

G-D1.rule: per seed: reloaded state_sha256 == N's; per-unit differences to N: candidate scores <= 1e-4, D1 window NLL <= 1e-5, D2 letter scores <= 1e-4; predictions identical except near-ties (top-2 gap <= 1e-4 in either evaluation, Pilot G0.8)

G-D2.rule: sigma_N(D1-all), sigma_N(D1-diff), sigma_N(D1-same), sigma_N(D2) finite and > 0

G-D4.rule: P+ seed 101: evaluation at the end of training and after save / reload (state_sha256 equal); tolerances as G-D1

G-D5.rule: report only: P+ (D1-diff, D2) per seed; after the DEV curves, Spearman correlation of D1-diff and D2 over all trained-model DEV evaluations

gate_d.pass: G-D1 and G-D2 and G-D3 and G-D4; otherwise ST14

margin.formula: m(M) = 2 * sigma_N(M), M in D1-all, D1-diff, D1-same, D2
margin.timing: after Gate D passes; committed and pushed before any training of section 10 step 6 (ST15)

comparison.primary: TEST, t = 0.80, D1-diff, Delta(L-F) and Delta(A-F); Bonferroni over the 2: 97.5% CI
comparison.secondary: all other points, metrics, DEV comparisons and per-method damages: 95% CI, words marked secondary
comparison.words: superior: hi < 0 and all 3 seed estimates < 0; non-inferior: not superior, hi < m and all 3 seed estimates < m; inferior: lo > m and all 3 seed estimates > m; inconclusive otherwise
